artifact_policy: Retain exact split rows, base rollouts, rejection provenance, tokenized features, every checkpoint adapter and generation, metrics, audits, and a dataset-attribution notice.
claim_boundary: A passing development result is a candidate only. Report class-balanced accuracy, per-class supports, parse rate, and exact-match together so majority-label behavior is visible.

compute_limits.device: CPU only; CUDA and MPS placement are forbidden
compute_limits.network: disabled during formal runs; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, local_files_only=true

dataset.confirmation_reservation: No confirmation rows are opened. Fresh validation hash ranks 1024–1535 are reserved for a separately locked confirmation if a development arm passes.
dataset.leakage_boundary: BoolQ is a public benchmark; pretraining exposure cannot be ruled out. Pilot ranks 0–23 are excluded from formal train data. Train and validation official splits remain separate.
dataset.pilot_exclusion: The 24 train rows at question-passage SHA-256 ranks 0–23 were used only in a private feasibility probe; none enter this formal training cohort. The official validation split was not opened during the pilot.
dataset.preference_construction: base_rollout_boolq: the chosen completion is the official answer key (Yes/No). The reject is the frozen base model greedy answer when incorrect or unparsable; if the base answer is correct, flip only the label. These verifier-constructed pairs are not human preferences.
dataset.prompt: Pinned Qwen chat template. Include the full passage and question. Ask for exactly one word, Yes or No, using the passage only. Do not truncate passage text.
dataset.revision: cached datasets snapshot, pinned by split fingerprints and Arrow hashes
dataset.selection: Training rows are hash-ranked by SHA-256(question + newline + passage); ranks 0–151 are excluded because the format pilot and v16 used those rows. Use ranks 152–279 for training. Validation uses the same deterministic hash ranking within the official validation split; ranks 0–767 are reserved to the prior v16 study/confirmation boundary, and v17 uses ranks 768–1023. No question-passage hashes may overlap across splits.

generation.source: Pinned Qwen generation_config.json; no repetition penalty to avoid suppressing Yes/No tokens that occur in the passage.

learner.adapter: Custom low-rank residual on frozen output-head hidden states over the full vocabulary. Transformer backbone and original output-head weights are frozen; this is not PEFT/TRL.
learner.initialization: A sampled from N(0, 1/sqrt(hidden_size)) by a CPU torch.Generator seeded per run; B initialized to zero.
learner.objective: Sequence-level DPO plus 0.05 times chosen-answer token-mean cross-entropy.

metrics.claim_boundary: A passing development result is a candidate only. Report accuracy together with class-balanced accuracy and per-class counts so majority-label behavior is visible.
metrics.generation_metric: Greedy decode with the frozen prompt and generation settings. Count a strict match only if the entire decoded completion is Yes or No (optionally followed by a period), matching the answer key. Other text is unparseable and incorrect. Report class-balanced accuracy, per-class support/accuracy, parse rate and Exact Match.
metrics.paired_comparison: Compare DPO, matched answer SFT and anchored DPO on identical questions, seeds and base rollouts. Report paired question-bootstrap intervals descriptively; validation selects checkpoints.
metrics.selection_primary: Mean validation class-balanced accuracy over strict Yes/No exact-match, averaged over the three seeds; higher is better.
metrics.selection_rule: For each method, retain nonzero epochs with mean verifier-preference NLL below base and mean full-vocabulary token KL <=0.5. Greedy-generate every eligible epoch on all 256 validation questions for each seed. Select highest mean class-balanced accuracy; break ties by higher mean exact-match, lower NLL, then fewer epochs. An arm advances only if base exact-match is at least 128/256, base class-balanced accuracy is at least 0.50, mean updated class-balanced accuracy improves by at least 0.05, and at least two of three seeds are no worse in class-balanced accuracy. Any development candidate requires a fresh, separately locked confirmation; development never establishes capability.
selection_secondary: mean full-vocabulary token KL updated-to-base on paired completion contexts

purpose: Fresh matched BoolQ post-training study testing a tenfold lower learning rate after KL or task-regression non-passes in v16.
